name: clutter
description: The clutter study: the swarm against one drone, standing and roaming a city with no task, over a grid of Voronoi city designs -- block spacing p (the cells' mean pitch) x coverage alpha (the arena's built share) -- built as VoronoiCityWorld is (DiamondCityWorld's building mix at size 1, blocks filled evenly, 12 m streets, 4 m facade gaps), with no goal patches. Conditions: the single drone and the swarm at spreads 0.4, 1.0 and 1.6, every one of a walk on the same random-walk intent chain (citysim.pilots rw, mean run 120 m) from the same start. A cell the generator jams in is reported, not flown.
